title: Loss Curvature as a Sampling-Free Proxy for Memorization in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding the mechanism behind why diffusion models memorize their training data remains an open question in generative modeling. In this paper, we examine this question from two perspectives: (a) the model-level perspective concerning the onset of memorization in a model during training, and (b) the sample-level perspective concerning the proclivity of an individual sample to be memorized by a given model. We show that the so-called input loss curvature, or the Frobenius norm of the Hessian of the diffusion model's training loss, is an effective metric for quantifying both perspectives on memorization. In particular, we empirically demonstrate that input curvatures averaged across training and validation samples can identify when a model is likely to start regurgitating its training data when tracked over training time. However, this metric is not sufficient for measuring an individual sample's likelihood of being memorized. To addr

translated_title: 损失曲率作为扩散模型记忆化的免采样代理指标
translated_abstract: 理解扩散模型为何会记忆其训练数据背后的机制，仍是生成式建模中一个悬而未决的问题。本文从两个视角考察这一问题：(a) 模型层面，即模型在训练过程中何时开始出现记忆化；(b) 样本层面，即单个样本被给定模型记忆的倾向性。我们证明，所谓的输入损失曲率，即扩散模型训练损失Hessian矩阵的Frobenius范数，是量化这两个记忆化视角的有效指标。特别是，我们通过实验证明，在训练过程中持续追踪训练样本与验证样本上平均的输入曲率，可以识别模型何时可能开始复现其训练数据。然而，该指标不足以衡量单个样本被记忆的可能性。为解决……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出输入损失曲率（训练损失Hessian矩阵的Frobenius范数）可作为扩散模型记忆化的免采样代理指标，通过在训练中追踪其均值即可预测模型何时开始记忆并复现训练数据。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that input loss curvature (the Frobenius norm of the Hessian of the diffusion model's training loss) serves as a sampling-free proxy for memorization, and tracking its average over training time can predict when a model begins to regurgitate its training data.
